picks.editorial_note: A £10M, nearly 700,000-participant trial co-led by Cambridge is the largest-ever test of AI-assisted mammography, with the potential to reshape national breast cancer screening if results hold.
picks.title: Cambridge co-leading world’s largest trial to use AI to help detect breast cancers earlier

picks.title: Indiana University receives $25M from Lilly Endowment to drive AI innovation

picks.editorial_note: Aalto's role coordinating FCAI-X, one of only six national AI Flagship centers in Finland, signals significant government-backed consolidation of the country's AI research strategy.
picks.title: Aalto coordinates new AI research flagship and is involved in four others | Aalto University
